title: TuiStore: find, search, and one-key-install hundreds of terminal apps, without leaving the terminal
description:
TuiStore is an app store for terminal software, but it doesn’t replace the package managers already on your machine. It detects your OS and available toolchains, then ranks compatible install methods across Homebrew, Cargo, uv, Docker, and more. Before anything runs, you see the exact command and whether it’s verified, scraped, or guessed. That transparency matters when “one-key install” would otherwise mean blindly trusting a shell command. #github #opensource  

https://github.com/Gheat1/tuistore
